knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The standard sets the pass level for high-risk areas at 90 per cent.
Half of the rooms in a moderate area are audited in each three-month period, so 10 of 20.
The previous audit shows which rooms or sections were covered and which actions remain open, so the rotation and follow-up are correct.

practicalCriteria: Assessor gives a sample area and risk class and the learner states the rooms to audit this period, with the correct count and rotation
Learner calculates whether a sample area score of 88 per cent meets its level for a named class, with the correct answer
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor record of the rotation exercise
stopWorkCriteria: Audit reveals an immediate risk to patients that requires action before the audit ends
The area's risk class is unknown and cannot be confirmed
